frozen_before: Task 1; no measured run of this plan has happened
rule: Values are the plan's agent-selected targets, copied unchanged. A miss stays a miss: no target, case or workload changes after a result; a change needs a recorded successor disposition.

backups.prune_requires: a newer verified generation; never the last usable one, never foreign or unknown directories
backups.format: optimus-agent-memory-repo/2 generation bytes unchanged (MEMORY.md, entries.jsonl, manifest.json)
backups.publication: exclusive staging, flush/fsync, verify, atomic publish
backups.cloud_write: each write needs its own named release; consent binds the resolved target and plaintext disclosure
backups.encryption: unavailable; an encrypted request writes nothing

import.commit: per item through the ordinary Gate, fence, expected state and durable commit; resumable, not atomic

k2_contention.rule: Backup and import run beside the Plan 12.11 K2 writer arrangement; the K2 targets in reports/plan12-memory-m3/targets.json apply unchanged (ack p95 1.5 s; projection after ack p95 250 ms; RSS 1 GiB; persistence disk 4 GiB; acknowledged write loss 0). A miss under contention is retained, never re-targeted. Backup and import durations are observations only: no duration threshold exists.

projects.why: K2's writers each hold their own project lease for their whole load (tools/plan12_memory/m3_k2.py); backup and import use a fifth project so they interleave with the writers at the store and route, without competing for a writer's lease

leases.writers: each acquires its project's lease once before the barrier (ttl 300 s, renewed as m3_k2.py does) and releases it after its last event
leases.import: the host acquires p-bi-0's lease at apply start and releases it when import status settles

initial_population.generator: m3_k2.py _item(4, slot) and _statement(4, slot, 1) for slots 0-9999 (client index 4), unchanged
initial_population.written: before the window, with p-bi-0's lease then released

import_leg.generator: random.Random(1212): entry i has statement 'p1212 import entry <i>: ' followed by seeded lowercase words to a length drawn uniformly from 200 to 2000 characters inclusive; one Agent Memory Repo MEMORY.md plus ten topic files of 100 entries each

k2_contention.barrier: starts when every writer has received 2000 acknowledgements; at the barrier, backup generation 1 and the import apply start together

backup_leg.expected_inventory: derived from each generation's observed head: the 10,000 initial items plus the import items confirmed at that head; never a fixed count
backup_leg.target: the released test directory on the separate physical disk

k2_contention.overlap_requirement: every writer must still be writing when generation 2 is verified; otherwise the contention evidence is INCOMPLETE and is reported as such, never as a pass
k2_contention.measurement_interval: from the barrier to the last of: writer window end, generation 2 verified, import status settled
k2_contention.evidence: backups.json contention section: ack p95, projection p95, RSS, disk and loss count against their targets; backup and import durations as observations; overlap established or INCOMPLETE

two_route_continuity_proof.status: no eligible second route at Task 0

paid_release_proposals.note: proposals, not releases; each paid run needs its own named release
